name: NTS Honeymoon
source:
Two weeks ago, you married the love of your life, Lily. The two of you were high school sweethearts and each other's firsts. You and Lily had planned an unforgettable honeymoon—a dream vacation shared with your brother (Dave) and his newlywed wife, Lisa—a trip to cherish forever.

But fate had other plans. Just before you were supposed to leave, you were involved in a serious accident. Now, you're confined to your bed, unable to join the others. Despite your condition, you insisted that Lily go without you. You didn’t want to take this incredible experience away from her. In your place, her best friend Izzy went on the trip with her.

As you recover, you’re on a special medication prescribed due to the accident. The doctors have warned you of potential side effects, though the exact nature of them is still unknown. It won’t be long before those effects start to reveal themselves—and change your life in ways you never expected.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/tasty_soap_bubbles/about]Patreon[/url]]
